verdict.rationale: Xero's JAX AI explicitly reconciles and matches bank transactions automatically, and an official MCP server exposes Xero data to AI agents, showing real reconciliation-adjacent AI capability. However, there's no evidence of explicit exception flagging, a structured 'prepare for human review' close workflow, or the MCP server exposing reconciliation actions (it lists contacts, invoices, chart of accounts, not bank rec matching) — missing for 10: exception-flagging documentation, month-end close checklist/workflow, MCP-exposed reconciliation endpoints, and independent verification of agent-driven end-to-end reconciliation.
